title: inventory/topology-observed.json
description: Observed physical topology (Kind snapshot). Health Device, topology mode only. One file, rewritten after every device probed. Each devices[] row is what ONE device reported about itself: version, interfaces with addresses, and its CDP/LLDP neighbors exactly as returned. The nurse never merges two devices' reports, never decides which report is stale, never reads descriptions. A reader pairs neighbors[] rows across devices mechanically. changes[] is the ring of what moved between maps, per device. Everything here is observed. No config, no counters, no health.

keys.description: Every device key in devices[] plus every interface key that appears as a neighbors[].local or neighbors[].far.

status.description: ok: every device in scope probed. gaps: at least one device failed or the map is still in progress. unavailable: nothing probed.

headline.description: Devices probed / in scope, neighbor rows recorded, unresolved neighbor names, then what changed since prior_mapped_at (or 'first map').

scope.description: "all" or the device keys the task line named.

state.description: partial while devices remain or a device failed.

neighbor_protocol_absent.description: Devices where CDP and LLDP both returned 204/404/empty.

devices.description: One row per inventory/prod.json device in scope. Rows are written one device at a time; a device not yet probed this map keeps its prior row (or is absent on a first map).

changes.description: Ring of the last 20 change events, oldest first. Each is a per-device comparison against that device's prior row. Empty on the first map.

keys.description: device:<name> plus interface keys of every neighbors[].local and resolved neighbors[].far.

node_definition.description: prod.json source_metadata.node_definition. Never from the device.

software_version.description: The token after 'Version ' in device-system-data software-version, e.g. 17.15.1a. Null when the call failed.

probed_at.description: When this device's three calls completed. Null when carried over from a prior map because collection failed.

name.description: Full IOS name, e.g. GigabitEthernet1, Loopback0, GigabitEthernet3.51.

cidr.description: Primary IPv4 as address/prefix, null when the interface has no address.

interfaces.description: Every interface the device returned, including Loopback and shut ones. Name and address only — never description.

neighbors.description: One row per CDP (or LLDP) entry this device returned, as returned. Do not drop, merge, or reconcile rows.

far_name.description: device-name as returned, domain suffix removed. Kept even when resolved.

far_port.description: port-id as returned, short form expanded (Gi1 -> GigabitEthernet1).

far.description: interface:<prod.json name>/<far_port> when far_name matches a prod.json device case-insensitively; null when it does not (the neighbor is unknown to inventory).

platform_hint.description: CDP platform string when present. Only useful when far is null.

subject.description: neighbor_*: the local interface key. interface_*: the interface name. version_changed / device_*: the device key.
